source_grounding.note: The delete path carries explicit intent evidence: the maintainer docstring '/// Delete alias if exists' on BOTH DeleteAlias and DeleteAliasOperation structs (also propagated into the JsonSchema/OpenAPI description of the delete_alias action), plus a deliberately modeled Ok(None) return that skips the state save when nothing was removed — the unknown-alias case is a designed outcome, not an unannotated oversight. The in-family contrast (rename_alias explicitly raises not_found) shows the codebase distinguishes the two cases on purpose. Therefore validation_absent does not hold and by_design_in_source is recorded per the v3.4 tightened rule. Caveat for the auditor: by-design here is relative to the SOURCE; the contract's 404/500 clause for this branch is not grounded in the documentation (chain_broken_at: doc), so the remaining question is contract quality, not source behavior.
